recipe_001.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipe_001.instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente. Fry pancetta in a pan until crispy. In a bowl, whisk eggs with grated parmesan and black pepper. Remove pan from heat, add hot pasta and pancetta, then quickly stir in the egg mixture. Toss vigorously so the sauce coats the pasta. Serve immediately with extra parmesan.

recipe_002.name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
recipe_002.instructions: Toast the bread slices. Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and olive oil. Fry or poach the eggs to your liking. Spread avocado mixture on toast, top with egg, sprinkle chili flakes. Serve immediately.

recipe_003.name: Chicken Stir Fry
recipe_003.instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. Slice chicken and vegetables. Heat oil in a wok, stir-fry garlic and ginger for 1 minute. Add chicken and cook until golden. Add vegetables and soy sauce, stir-fry 5 minutes. Drizzle sesame oil and serve over rice.

recipe_004.name: Red Lentil Soup
recipe_004.instructions: Dice onion, carrots, and tomatoes. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft. Add cumin, carrots, and tomatoes, cook 3 minutes. Add lentils and broth, bring to a boil. Simmer 25 minutes until lentils are tender. Blend partially for a creamy texture. Season and serve.

recipe_005.name: Greek Salad
recipe_005.instructions: Chop tomatoes and cucumber into chunks. Thinly slice red onion. Combine vegetables and olives in a bowl. Top with crumbled feta. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano. Toss gently and serve.

recipe_006.name: Beef Tacos
recipe_006.instructions: Dice onion and tomatoes. Brown ground beef in a pan, add cumin and chili powder. Warm taco shells in the oven. Fill shells with beef, topped with tomatoes, shredded lettuce, grated cheddar, and a dollop of sour cream.

recipe_007.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipe_007.instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft. Add sliced mushrooms, cook 5 minutes. Add arborio rice and toast 2 minutes. Pour in wine and stir until absorbed. Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until each addition is absorbed (~20 min). Stir in parmesan, season, and serve.

recipe_008.name: Banana Pancakes
recipe_008.instructions: Mash banana in a bowl. Whisk in eggs, milk, and melted butter. Add flour, baking powder, and salt; stir until just combined. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour small ladlefuls of batter, cook 2-3 min per side until golden. Serve with maple syrup.

recipe_009.name: Margherita Pizza
recipe_009.instructions: Preheat oven to 250°C. Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface. Spread tomato sauce, top with torn mozzarella. Bake 10-12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese bubbles. Remove from oven, add fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil. Slice and serve.

recipe_010.name: Caesar Salad
recipe_010.instructions: Wash and chop romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Toss with caesar dressing and lemon juice. Add croutons and grated parmesan. Season with black pepper. Serve immediately.

recipe_011.name: Salmon Teriyaki
recipe_011.instructions: Cook rice. Mix soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger for the teriyaki glaze. Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Sear salmon 3-4 minutes per side. Pour glaze over salmon and cook 2 more minutes until caramelized. Serve over rice, garnish with sliced spring onion.

recipe_012.name: Vegetable Curry
recipe_012.instructions: Cook rice. Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add curry powder and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes and chickpeas, cook 5 minutes. Pour in coconut milk, simmer 10 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

recipe_013.name: French Omelette
recipe_013.instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour in eggs, stirring gently with a spatula while shaking the pan. When eggs are just set but still slightly glossy, fold the omelette in thirds. Slide onto a plate, garnish with chopped chives.

recipe_014.name: Shakshuka
recipe_014.instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper in olive oil until soft. Add cumin and paprika, cook 1 minute. Add chopped tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes. Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 5-7 minutes until eggs are set. Crumble feta on top and serve.

recipe_015.name: Cheese Quesadillas
recipe_015.instructions: Dice bell pepper and onion. Butter one side of each tortilla. Place one tortilla butter-side down in a pan, add grated cheese, peppers, and onion. Top with second tortilla butter-side up. Cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts. Cut into wedges, serve with sour cream.

recipe_016.name: Pad Thai
recipe_016.instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water 20 minutes, drain. Fry tofu until golden, set aside. Scramble eggs in the pan. Add noodles, soy sauce, and lime juice, stir-fry 3 minutes. Add tofu, bean sprouts, and spring onion. Serve topped with crushed peanuts and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipe_017.name: Caprese Salad
recipe_017.instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into equal rounds. Alternate slices on a plate. Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately at room temperature.

recipe_018.name: Dal Tadka
recipe_018.instructions: Rinse lentils and simmer in broth with turmeric for 20 minutes until soft. In a separate pan, melt butter and fry cumin seeds until they pop. Add onion and garlic, cook until golden. Add tomatoes and garam masala, cook 5 minutes. Pour the tadka over the lentils, stir and serve.

recipe_019.name: Overnight Oats
recipe_019.instructions: Mix oats, milk, yogurt, and honey in a jar or bowl. Slice banana and stir in half. Cover and refrigerate overnight. In the morning, top with remaining banana slices and fresh blueberries. Add more milk if too thick.

recipe_020.name: Tuna Pasta Salad
recipe_020.instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, rinse with cold water and drain. Halve cherry tomatoes, dice cucumber and red onion. Drain tuna. Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, and olive oil for dressing. Combine pasta, vegetables, and tuna. Add dressing, toss well, season with salt. Serve cold.

recipe_021.name: Pumpkin Soup
recipe_021.instructions: Dice pumpkin, onion, and garlic. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add pumpkin and ginger, cook 3 minutes. Add broth and simmer 20 minutes until pumpkin is tender. Blend until smooth. Stir in coconut milk, season with salt. Serve with a swirl of coconut milk.

recipe_022.name: Beef Stir Fry
recipe_022.instructions: Cook rice. Slice beef and vegetables. Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry garlic 30 seconds. Add beef and cook 2-3 minutes. Add vegetables, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Stir-fry 3-4 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Drizzle sesame oil. Serve over rice.

recipe_023.name: Spinach Omelette
recipe_023.instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a pan. Sauté spinach 1 minute until wilted. Pour eggs over spinach. Cook on medium-low, lifting edges to let raw egg flow underneath. When nearly set, crumble feta on one half. Fold and serve immediately.

recipe_024.name: Lamb Chops with Rosemary
recipe_024.instructions: Mix olive oil, rosemary, crushed garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Coat lamb chops and marinate 15 minutes. Heat a cast iron pan to high heat. Sear chops 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipe_025.name: Veggie Burger
recipe_025.instructions: Mash chickpeas in a bowl, leaving some texture. Finely dice onion and garlic. Mix chickpeas with oats, onion, garlic, cumin, and paprika. Form into 4 patties. Pan-fry 4 minutes per side until golden. Serve in buns with lettuce and sliced tomatoes.

recipe_026.name: Prawn Linguine
recipe_026.instructions: Cook linguine until al dente. Sauté garlic and chili flakes in olive oil. Add prawns, cook 2 minutes per side. Add white wine and cherry tomatoes, simmer 3 minutes. Toss with drained pasta and chopped parsley. Serve immediately.

recipe_027.name: Bruschetta
recipe_027.instructions: Dice tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and salt. Toast baguette slices. Rub warm toast with a halved garlic clove. Spoon tomato mixture on top. Serve immediately.

recipe_028.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipe_028.instructions: Season chicken with salt and cook in olive oil 5-6 minutes per side. Slice chicken. Warm tortillas. Layer romaine lettuce, sliced chicken, and grated parmesan on each tortilla. Drizzle with caesar dressing. Roll tightly and slice in half.

recipe_029.name: Miso Soup
recipe_029.instructions: Bring broth to a gentle simmer — do not boil. Whisk miso paste into a ladle of warm broth until dissolved, then add back to pot. Cube tofu and add to soup. Add seaweed. Ladle into bowls and garnish with sliced spring onion.

recipe_030.name: Lemon Chicken
recipe_030.instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Mix olive oil, lemon juice, crushed garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper. Score chicken thighs and coat with marinade. Place in a baking dish with lemon slices. Roast 35-40 minutes until golden and cooked through. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipe_031.name: Falafel Bowl
recipe_031.instructions: Blend chickpeas, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, and parsley until coarse. Mix in flour. Shape into small balls and pan-fry in oil until golden, about 3 minutes per side. Cook rice. Serve falafel over rice with tahini drizzled on top.

recipe_032.name: Penne Arrabbiata
recipe_032.instructions: Cook penne until al dente. Sauté garlic and chili flakes in olive oil 1 minute. Add chopped tomatoes, season with salt, simmer 15 minutes. Toss with drained pasta. Tear fresh basil leaves on top and serve.

recipe_033.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipe_033.instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Add garlic and stir-fry 30 seconds. Push to one side, scramble eggs in the wok. Add rice and peas, stir-fry 3-4 minutes. Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss everything together. Garnish with sliced spring onion.

recipe_034.name: Baked Salmon
recipe_034.instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Place salmon and asparagus on a lined baking tray. Mix olive oil, lemon juice, crushed garlic, and dill. Pour over salmon and asparagus. Season with salt. Bake 15-18 minutes until salmon flakes easily. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipe_035.name: Tomato Basil Soup
recipe_035.instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft. Add chopped tomatoes and broth, simmer 20 minutes. Add most of the basil and blend until smooth. Stir in cream and season with salt. Serve with remaining fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipe_036.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipe_036.instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the garam masala for 20 minutes. Grill or pan-fry chicken until charred. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add remaining spices, tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes. Blend sauce, add cream and chicken. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipe_037.name: Zucchini Fritters
recipe_037.instructions: Grate zucchini, sprinkle with salt, let sit 10 minutes. Squeeze out excess water. Mix with eggs, flour, grated parmesan, and minced garlic. Heat oil in a pan. Fry spoonfuls of batter 3 minutes per side until golden. Serve with sour cream or yogurt.

recipe_038.name: French Onion Soup
recipe_038.instructions: Slice onions thinly. Melt butter and caramelize onions on low heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add wine, thyme, and broth. Simmer 15 minutes. Ladle into oven-safe bowls. Top with toasted baguette slices and grated gruyere. Broil until cheese is bubbly and golden.

recipe_039.name: Black Bean Bowl
recipe_039.instructions: Cook rice. Drain and rinse black beans, warm in a pan with cumin and olive oil. Slice avocado and toss with lime juice. Assemble bowls: rice, black beans, corn, and avocado. Season with salt and an extra squeeze of lime.

recipe_040.name: Pesto Pasta
recipe_040.instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan, and olive oil until smooth. Season with salt. Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 2 tbsp pasta water. Toss hot pasta with pesto and a splash of pasta water to loosen. Serve with extra parmesan.

recipe_041.name: Teriyaki Tofu
recipe_041.instructions: Press tofu dry and cube. Mix soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger for teriyaki sauce. Pan-fry tofu in sesame oil until golden on all sides. Add teriyaki sauce and cook 2-3 minutes until caramelized. Cook rice. Serve tofu over rice, sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipe_042.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipe_042.instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C. Cook rice halfway. Brown beef with onion and garlic. Mix with rice and diced tomatoes. Cut tops off peppers, remove seeds. Fill with beef mixture. Top with mozzarella. Place in baking dish with a splash of water. Bake 30 minutes until peppers are tender.

recipe_043.name: Gazpacho
recipe_043.instructions: Roughly chop all vegetables. Blend tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, and garlic until smooth. Add olive oil, red wine vinegar, and salt. Blend again. Adjust seasoning. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Serve cold with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipe_044.name: Coconut Curry Soup
recipe_044.instructions: Soak rice noodles in hot water 5 minutes. Fry red curry paste 1 minute. Add coconut milk and broth, bring to a simmer. Add cubed tofu and sliced mushrooms, cook 5 minutes. Add spinach and noodles, cook 2 more minutes. Season with lime juice and serve.

recipe_045.name: Spanish Tortilla
recipe_045.instructions: Slice potatoes and onion thinly. Fry slowly in olive oil 20 minutes until soft but not crispy. Drain and cool. Beat eggs with salt, mix in potatoes and onion. Heat a little oil in a pan, pour in egg mixture. Cook on medium-low 5 minutes. Flip carefully and cook other side 3 minutes.

recipe_046.name: Roasted Vegetable Tray Bake
recipe_046.instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Chop all vegetables into chunks. Toss with olive oil, crushed garlic, and oregano. Spread on a large baking tray. Roast 30-35 minutes until golden and tender, turning halfway. Crumble feta cheese over the top and serve.

recipe_047.name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
recipe_047.instructions: Slice bagels in half and toast. Spread cream cheese generously on each half. Layer smoked salmon on top. Add thinly sliced red onion and capers. Squeeze lemon juice over everything. Garnish with fresh dill and serve immediately.

recipe_048.name: Minestrone
recipe_048.instructions: Dice all vegetables. Sauté onion, garlic, carrots, and celery in olive oil 5 minutes. Add tomatoes, broth, and beans. Bring to a boil, add zucchini and pasta. Simmer 15 minutes until pasta is cooked. Season generously. Serve with crusty bread.

recipe_049.name: Chicken Fajitas
recipe_049.instructions: Slice chicken, peppers, and onion into strips. Toss chicken with cumin, paprika, lime juice, and olive oil. Stir-fry chicken 5-6 minutes in a hot pan. Add peppers and onion, cook 3-4 more minutes. Warm tortillas. Fill with chicken mixture and a dollop of sour cream.

recipe_050.name: Bircher Muesli
recipe_050.instructions: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, and lemon juice. Grate apple and stir in. Cover and refrigerate overnight. In the morning, stir in honey. Top with sliced almonds and fresh blueberries. Add extra milk if too thick.
